purpose: Freeze runtime behavior that is added after the apparent class definitions are loaded.

conditions: Installed through a meta-path hook before sonar.fishing.bot executes.
override_groups.observable_behavior: Changes bait restart, fishing preparation, trophy classification, start input, and debug catch artifact behavior.
override_groups.evidence_gap: A single end-to-end trace of every adjusted method is not yet frozen.
override_groups.removal_condition: The corresponding whole C++ capabilities pass offline parity, read-only shadow where applicable, authority cutover, and rollback window.

override_groups.target_owner: Fishing C# Host presentation and feature policy
conditions: Enabled only for direct non-frozen Python debug mode; otherwise chat UI is hidden and disabled.
override_groups.observable_behavior: Marks the stream chat UI as WIP when enabled and prevents chat-mode entry when disabled.
override_groups.evidence_gap: The debug-enabled and frozen UI variants do not yet have a dedicated visual characterization test.
override_groups.removal_condition: WPF feature policy reproduces the accepted enabled and disabled variants and the Python production UI has left its rollback window.

override_groups.target_owner: Fishing C# Host streaming application service
conditions: Mutating chat methods are replaced when the WIP gate is disabled.
override_groups.observable_behavior: Returns a stable unavailable snapshot, clears transient chat state, and prevents all chat mutations.
override_groups.evidence_gap: The disabled-method replacement set is frozen structurally but its complete observable result matrix is not yet characterized.
override_groups.removal_condition: C# streaming policy has typed unavailable results and parity tests, then the Python Host rollback window expires.

conditions: Applied for both enabled and disabled chat WIP modes.
override_groups.observable_behavior: Removes the Telegram chat-mode hint before sending or editing a message.
side_effects: Telegram text normalization before network send
override_groups.evidence_gap: Exact multiline normalization examples are not yet covered by a dedicated test.
override_groups.removal_condition: The C# Telegram adapter owns the normalized message contract and Python Host production removal is complete.

override_groups.activation: Import sonar.streaming.StreamingService instead of the base service module class.
override_groups.target_owner: Fishing C# Host streaming application service
conditions: Base status is preparing, stream is inactive, and no public stream URL exists.
override_groups.observable_behavior: Exposes the semantic status offline instead of preparing.
override_groups.removal_condition: The C# streaming snapshot mapper passes semantic parity and the Python Host rollback window expires.

conditions: Installed through a meta-path hook before sonar.telegram.notifier executes.
override_groups.observable_behavior: Currently adds only an idempotent adjustment marker; the hook itself remains part of effective load behavior.
override_groups.removal_condition: Python Telegram production code and its import hook are removed after Host cutover and rollback.
